gherkin.then: 36525 succeeds, 36526 returns the exact shared P008-CONFIG invalid-policy behavior envelope, Infinity retains the shared non-finite field path, 100100000 returns shared invalid-policy without RangeError, and the existing local brief error wins for the doubly invalid input
